selection.method: Agent-selected 100 sentences with an explicit, semantically reviewed proper-name label in the original raw transcript; retain official first-occurrence sentence order. Take that sentence_id first audio row. No selection used ASR output, acoustic difficulty or recognition results.
selection.name_scope: Countries, places, people, organizations, explicit technical names and other unambiguous named celestial bodies, historical documents/periods, religious observances, storms or operations. No ordinary sentence-initial capitalized word, demonym alone, month/day name, invented expansion or guessed identity. Observed surnames remain observed surnames.
selection.positive_label_review: agent reviewed source human transcript, not independent human entity audit
selection.note_semantics: Hypothetical user note containing only the original reviewed name in Markdown bold; not a note supplied by the FLEURS speaker.
selection.wire_eligibility: Complete observed labels use only Unicode alphanumeric characters and ASCII spaces, at most80 characters, matching the existing hotword character contract. No punctuation removal, abbreviation expansion or phonetic alias is used to create a label.
selection.negative_pairing: Choose another reviewed case label absent from both references; prefer same name_kind, then highest NFKC-casefolded compact character SequenceMatcher ratio, ties earlier selected case. This is a deterministic lexical/entity-type preference, not a phonetic equivalence judgment.
selection.negative_absence: Require normalized whole token-sequence absence and compact-substring absence from both raw and normalized references; also reject accent-folded compact matches conservatively. Thus a name such as York inside New York is ineligible as an unspoken hint.
selection.negative_normalization: NFKC then casefold, Unicode alphanumeric token runs; compact concatenates those runs. The additional accent-folded compact check removes combining marks after NFKD.

limitations: These are100 real read-speech audio clusters, each evaluated twice with different hypothetical notes; not200 independent recordings. Multiple sentences can share an entity label.
Labels were agent reviewed against the official human transcript, not independently audited by a human annotator and not verified by listening in this selection task.
Negative hints are genuinely absent by the declared reference checks and come from other reviewed labels; not every pair is near-sounding or acoustically confusable.
This English held-out FLEURS subset is not a conversational, Chinese, natural code-switching, microphone, speaker-diarization or arbitrary proper-name coverage claim.
The metadata/reference is pinned here. The separate audio manifest must bind actual original archive members, audio hashes and decoded PCM before any ASR result is accepted.
No ASR model, TTS, model-derived recognition output, download or performance result was used to author or tune this fixture.
